title: Durban customs update: a new depot code to check.
description: SARS has added a new Durban container depot, sub-number J8, to the facility codes used in Box 30 on the Goods Declaration.
cta: CargoIQ | Keep the source with the record.

blocks.text: The addition enables Customs to send electronic consignment-status messages to the facility.
For clearing teams, a practical check: confirm the facility code against the updated list when preparing declarations.

sources.title: SARS: Customs Registration, Licensing and Accreditation update
